findings: The first checkpoint lacked required inspected anchors and was rejected; checkpoint02 was then accepted.
An initial draft publisher edited the earlier builder temporarily; its exact bytes were restored and the program history check subsequently passed.

Undefined citations before BibTeX are normal first-pass behavior. The actual bibliography blocker was a duplicate exec13_ci_examples key already used by commercial identification. The new key exec13_cimpact_examples avoids the collision; earlier diagnosis of bibliography order was incomplete.

The first draft build log was removed during a failed cleanup. The old preflight-failure.json log hash is not used as verified evidence. Later duplicate-key and overfull logs and two rendered preflight PDFs remain preserved.
Two literal extracted-text assertions did not match the actual prose and stopped after successful compilation. They were validation-script mistakes, not evidence of missing manuscript text.
A31.28pt overfull draw-list paragraph was repaired using display math; the following build reported no overfull or undefined warnings.
The initial section placement was late in a research chapter. The preserving final software wrapper moves it into the panel/synthetic-control chapter without changing earlier prose.
The original decision.tex was restored to its checkpoint02 hash. The corrected manuscript is decision-v2.tex; the runtime ledger check passes.
